hero.title: Accept Table Bookings 24/7 from Your Website

features.title: How Table Reservations Work
features.subtitle: Two steps from guest request to confirmed booking.

items.title: Guests Book from Your Website
items.description: Customers visit your restaurant page, tap 'Reserve a Table', choose a date and time, enter their details, and submit. No app needed — works in any browser on any device.

items.title: You Manage Bookings in Your Dashboard
items.description: Every reservation appears in your dashboard with guest name, phone, party size, date, and notes. Confirm or decline with one tap. Set automatic confirmation or review each booking manually.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Set up online reservations and start accepting bookings in five steps.

steps.title: Enable Reservations
steps.description: Toggle reservations on in your restaurant settings. Choose between automatic confirmation, where bookings are approved instantly based on availability, or manual mode where you review each request.

steps.title: Add Your Tables
steps.description: Create tables with capacity and zone information — for example, 'Table 5, 4 guests, Terrace'. Each table becomes bookable, and the system prevents double-bookings automatically.

steps.title: Set Working Hours
steps.description: Define your available hours for reservations and choose the slot duration — from 15 minutes to 8 hours. Only time slots within your working hours are shown to guests.

steps.title: Guests Book Online
steps.description: Customers visit your restaurant page, pick their date, time, and party size, enter their name and phone, and submit. No account or app download required — works in any browser.

steps.title: Manage Bookings in Your Dashboard
steps.description: View all reservations in your dashboard. Confirm, cancel, or mark bookings as completed. Both you and the guest receive email notifications for every booking update.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about table reservations.

items.question: Do customers need to create an account to book?
items.answer: No. Guests simply fill in their name, phone number, party size, and preferred time. No account or app download required.

items.question: Can I set available time slots and capacity?
items.answer: Yes. Define your working hours, reservation slot duration, and table capacity. The system only shows available slots to guests.

items.question: Will I get notified when someone books?
items.answer: Yes. You receive an email for every new reservation. Guests also get a confirmation email once you approve the booking.

items.question: Can I use both automatic and manual confirmation?
items.answer: Yes. Choose automatic mode to confirm bookings instantly based on availability, or manual mode to review and approve each request yourself.

items.question: How does the system prevent double bookings?
items.answer: Each table has a defined capacity and time slots. Once a table is booked for a specific time, it's no longer shown as available. The system handles all conflict detection automatically.

items.question: Can guests add special requests or notes?
items.answer: Yes. The reservation form includes a notes field where guests can mention dietary needs, celebrations, seating preferences, or any other requests.

items.question: Is the reservation feature available on the free plan?
items.answer: Table reservations are available on the Growth and Pro plans. The free plan includes your full QR menu, contact page, and analytics — upgrade anytime to enable reservations.

items.question: Can I see reservation history?
items.answer: Yes. All reservations — past and upcoming — are stored in your dashboard. You can filter by date, status, and table to review your booking history at any time.
